item.title: Approximately Up
item.description:
Title: Approximately Up
Genre: Adventure , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Approximately Games
Publisher: Approximately Games
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

Approximately Up is your best chance to experience spaceflight in whatever you and your crew (singleplayer or co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players ) can bolt together! Build epic spaceships or barely flying trashcans — it’s entirely up to you. Control your creation from a first-person view right from the deck of your ship . Complete challenging objectives, hunt achievements, face the dangers of space, and collect new components to expand your current spacecraft — or build hundreds of new ones. One is never enough!

Build spaceships!

Everything begins with a single piece of frame and grows into a massive, complex ship built from thousands of components. Create automated systems, experiment with different input controllers, sensors, and meters — connect them to whatever you need, and let the magic (or chaos) happen! Once it looks ready (or not), hit launch and see what happens!

Complete challenging objectives!

Experimental power sources that need to be delivered to a station on another planet — causing unexpected power outages mid-flight? Some strange energy crystal charging up like a ticking time bomb? Or maybe it’s just a massive, ridiculously heavy submarine this time? Can your spaceship handle that?

Explore the new planets!

Is the planet covered in oceans? What’s hiding beneath that thick atmosphere? Can you see the surface through those massive clouds? Everything’s waiting for you to find out! Explore 15 unique planets , each with its own look, feel, and dynamic soundtrack that changes in real time as you explore and make new discoveries!

Blame each other!

Who forgot to connect that cable? Who mounted the thruster backward? Who forgot the solar panels? Or the door-opening button? Is the radar working? How about the batteries? Enjoy the hilarious chaos in co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players — and find out once and for all... WHOSE FAULT WAS IT?!

So how does it works?

You start on Earth and slowly explore a system of 15 planets , each with its own size, gravity, atmosphere, temperature, and challenges that make every world feel different. Most planets have one or more Planet Stations , which work as checkpoints and garages where you can build ships and start new missions. When you land on a station, it unlocks permanently and becomes a new place you can launch from. To reach these planets, you build your own modular spaceships and experiment with different parts - electric engines, fuel engines, mixed fuels, solar panels, heat-resistant frames, and more. By completing missions like delivering components between planets, you earn new ship parts that let you create better and more advanced designs. All flights are fully first-person from inside your craft, and because distances are huge, your ship design really matters - some trips will take only minutes , while others can turn into long journeys if your ship is weak. The whole game is about exploring planets, upgrading your ships, unlocking new stations, and trying to make it to your destination without crashing.


Note: Demo currently supports English only. Additional languages will be available in the full release.

    • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 6 GB available space

item.title: Spiritstead
item.description:
Title: Spiritstead
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Turbo Dog Games
Publisher: Turbo Dog Games , Wings
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

Spiritstead is an easy-going and satisfying city builder. Arrive in a quiet, enchanted land where humans and magical spirits work together. Take charge and put your villagers to work as you create their homes, support their lives, and make your village beautiful along the way.

Overseeing the lives of so many can be hard work, but here you have a magical place full of spirits ready to help. Discover them through interactions with the world as you meet quirky, charming creatures who make each day in your village easier to manage. Collect them all to live alongside your people and create spirit buildings to support them.

Support your townsfolk by assigning them jobs, meeting all their needs, and helping them enjoy life with happiness-boosting buildings like cafes, markets, and bonfires. Unlock new buildings, decorations, and upgrades as you progress through the game to help you look after your residents.

Enjoy creating the town of your dreams in a stunning bespoke visual style inspired by Miyazaki films and your favorite cartoons, handcrafted by our talented artist. Beneath its comfortable atmosphere lie hidden secrets waiting to be discovered as you expand into new territories with the help of wandering spirits and work to restore the Grand Spirit Sanctuary, bringing balance between spirits and humans.

RELAXING AND SATISFYING

Create freely in creative mode without any pressures and just enjoy building. Here for a satisfying challenge? Manage your villagers needs and wants as you make something as aesthetically pleasing as it is practical in adventure mode.

A GENTLER EXPERIENCE

Enjoy an easy to learn, addictive city builder experience. Spiritstead is a simple yet satisfying city builder with fun clicker elements and takes around 4-7 hours to play through end to end in survival mode. Spiritstead is endlessly replayable, but the game world remains the same each time.

item.title: The Skin Stapler
item.description:
Title: The Skin Stapler
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Tainted Pact
Publisher: Assemble Entertainment
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

A serial killer stalks the streets, and you’re on their trail. Investigate the murders, descend into the city’s rotten underbelly, and uncover its buried secrets. Will you find the truth before The Skin Stapler finds you? Play as burned-out detective Dick Slater, hunting a serial killer known as the Skin Stapler. Take control of other characters as they are stalked through homes, workplaces, and dark city streets.

Victims are skinned, their flesh stapled to nearby walls. Distorted audio tapes taunt police and point to something darker beneath the city. You will scream. You might die. Maybe even from laugther.

A HANDCRAFTED HORROR EXPERIENCE

Handmade horror, with no shortcuts and plenty of sharp objects. Built as an XXL horror feature night, The Skin Stapler delivers a night of atmosphere, story, and bloody good fun.

MORE THAN DETECTIVE WORK

Investigate crime scenes as Detective Dick Slater, solve grisly puzzles, or survive a not-so-ordinary shift. Every character brings a different way to experience Carrion City’s nightmare.

FULLY VOICED

Every character is fully voiced, bringing Carrion City’s killers, victims, and burned-out cops to life.

GRINDHOUSE ATMOSPHERE

Inspired by 1980s VHS horror and exploitation films, the game features stylized violence, neon-lit decay, and an unapologetically grim aesthetic that blends horror and humor.

A CAST TO DIE FOR

From the creator of Suffer the Night , Terror at Oakheart , Massacre at the Mirage , and Flesh Made Fear , Tainted Pact Games invites you into a grimy, neon-lit nightmare with The Skin Stapler . Experience handcrafted indie horror made with support from some of your favourite content creators.



Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This game contains heavy depictions of blood, gore, horror, frightening scenes, violence, and is not suited for children and young people under the age of 18.

Action sequences involve violence against zombified humans and monsters.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Microsoft Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 1.8GHz / AMD Athlon X2 64 2.4GHz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 760 or higher
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Microsoft Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9600K CPU @ 3.70GHz or equivalent
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 or higher
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

item.title: Sovereign Tower
item.description:
Title: Sovereign Tower
Genre: Indie , RPG
Developer: WILD WITS GAMES
Publisher: Curve Games
Franchise: Curve Games
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

- Your Reign, Your Rules - Every choice you make defines your legacy and the fate of your Kingdom...

- Recruit eccentric Knights - Manage a court of unpredictable heroes with big egos and even bigger problems.

- Manage Your Round Table - Send Knights on quests where success or disaster hinges on your judgment.

- Bend Time and Tempt Fate - Rewind decisions, uncover secrets, and pursue forbidden romances.

- Expand Your Tower - Build new annexes, acquire upgrades, and outwit rival rulers.

Ah, finally - a suitable Sovereign for the job. Yes, you, right there, come sit on this comfy throne. Ah you like the feel of that, don’t you? Congratulations, you’re hired! My name is Arlin and I’m your advisor. Welcome to your first day, and please, allow me to provide thee with a day in the life of a Sovereign and you can then decide how will you rule, my liege...

- In the morning you must tend to your subjects and listen to the problems that plague the Kingdom. From gardening to exorcisms - there’s never a boring day on the throne.

- Each decision you make will shape your kingdom and relationships with individuals, collectives and other rulers. Every interaction will play a part in defining your legacy.

- Balance your affinity with the Merchants, Mystics, Scholars, Nobles and People , as well as the Treasury , or spend it all and backstab everyone. Either way works, my grace.

- Recruit eccentric Knights with strong personalities and questionable morals to serve at your Round Table. Unfortunately for you, these are the jesters you’re relying on to keep your Kingdom running smoothly.

- With great egos, comes great drama! These Knights aren’t going to be a walk in the Tower’s Garden, sire. There’s always advice to be taken, grievances to be shared and romance to be explored.

- You must keep your Knights satisfied otherwise they may just leave your court for good. Maybe that’s sometimes for the best though...

- Manage your Knights from the Round Table. Here you can view all the requests from your subjects that you obliged to earlier in the day. Assign the most equipped Knight for the job to reduce chances of failure.

- Your Knights possess stats: Strength, Agility, Charisma, Magic and Wit. Each Quest requires a different skill set. Need a Charismatic approach? Maybe we shouldn’t send Ursula, your grace.

- After they return from their Quests, you’ll be debriefed with the results of their venture. Did their efforts result in Critical Failure or Critical Success? Or did they experience a completely Unexpected Outcome?

- In the Crypts of the Tower dwells a Demon who can turn back time. So, if it all goes wrong, you can go back with all the knowledge you’ve learned, make alternate decisions and change fate.

- Of course, you have me, your main advisor at your service, but there are others. For example, The Intendant has a nosy habit of collecting secrets about your Knights. She’ll provide the juicy gossip as you require it it!

- If you like romancing stone statues, then you’ve come to the right place. No, really, go speak to the Lady of the Tower and find out.

- Prove your worthiness against opposers by joining hands with neighbouring counties and forging great alliances.

- Expand your Tower by adding new Annexes which in turn will allow for more positions to open amongst your court.

- From Carina’s Forge to the Witch’s Alchemy Room, each of these new Annexes gives you the ability to craft new items to assist your Knights on their Quests.

item.title: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
item.description:
Title: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
Genre: Indie , Simulation
Developer: Mandragora
Publisher: tinyBuild
Franchise: tinyBuild , Iron nest
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

ReStory is a chill, narrative-driven shop management simulator from the creators of I Am Future, set on the bustling streets of mid-2000s Tokyo and featuring an in-depth device repair system.

In this game, you run an electronics repair shop, meticulously restore nostalgic Y2K-era devices, including officially licensed Atari consoles, and interact with customers to experience a branching storyline with multiple endings that depend on your choices.

Greet customers, take their devices in for repairs, manage your finances, and surf the web for spare parts. Relax and enjoy running your own small shop in a game created with love and respect for the one-of-a-kind vibe of the Japanese urban life in the mid-2000s.

Fix a variety of nostalgic devices inspired by iconic game consoles, handhelds, phones, cameras, music players, and home appliances. Carefully take each gadget apart, clean it, replace faulty parts, and assemble it back together using your trusty toolset.

The way you interact with each customer can change their lives forever. Will you report on a disturbing find inside the former gangster’s phone, or help a lovestruck student confess to his crush? Make your own choices and see how they impact the branching storyline.

Key Features

  • Relaxing electronics repair shop management

  • A wide range of nostalgic 2000s devices to repair

  • In-depth device cleaning and restoration system

  • Y2K-era web browser to hunt for spare parts

  • A variety of in-person and online orders to fulfill

  • Multiple tools for device repairs

  • Iconic Atari consoles, officially licensed for the game

  • Customers with unique stories and dialogues

  • Replayable branching storyline with choices impacting the ending

  • A distinct, chill vibe of urban life in Japan

MacOS

    • Processor: Apple M1

    • Graphics: Apple integrated GPU (M1)
    • Storage: 1 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Requires an Apple processor
